description: Fork of exp104 with nap=9 for all 3 LUT modules (table_dim 256 -> 512, 2x larger). n_sparse=8 and tph (qk/v 384, out 2048) unchanged. Doubles LUT weights per module (qk/v: 4.72M -> 9.44M, out: 4.19M -> 8.39M, per layer 13.63M -> 27.27M). Total ~190M. Same total weights as exp119 (which doubled tph), but achieved via bigger tables instead of more tables.
